name: Redis High Availability
description: Redis replicas with Sentinel failover and HAProxy routing
readme:
# Redis High Availability

Companion template used to convert an existing Redis service (`haTemplateCode` of the `redis` template). It is not deployed on its own.

- **root**: the existing service becomes the primary (its volume and AOF data are kept).
- **replica**: Redis replicas. Every data node also runs a Sentinel, so the cluster always has an odd number of voters (3, 5, 7 or 9).
- **edge**: HAProxy health-checks every node with `INFO replication` and routes to the one reporting `role:master`. Connect with `${{<root>-ha.REDIS_URL}}`.

services.name: redis

haConversionConfig.description: 모든 Redis 노드에서 Sentinel이 함께 돌며, 과반수가 주 노드 장애에 동의하면 replica 하나를 승격합니다. AOF 영속성은 항상 켜져 있습니다.

replica.label: Redis replica
replica.description: 주 노드에 붙는 replica입니다. 짝수로 골라 Sentinel 투표 수(노드 전체)를 홀수로 유지합니다.

edge.label: 리버스 프록시
edge.description: 현재 주 노드로 연결을 보내는 HAProxy replica입니다.

services.start_command:
set -eu
ME="$KEEL_PRIVATE_DOMAIN"
PW="$REDIS_PASSWORD"
export REDISCLI_AUTH="$PW"
MASTER="${KEEL_HA_PRIMARY:-$ME}"
CONF=/data/sentinel.conf
if [ -f "$CONF" ]; then
  m=$(sed -n 's/^sentinel monitor keel \([^ ]*\) .*/\1/p' "$CONF" | head -n1)
  [ -n "$m" ] && MASTER="$m"
fi
for p in $(printf '%s' "${KEEL_HA_PEERS:-}" | tr ',' ' '); do
  [ "$p" = "$ME" ] && continue
  m=$(timeout 3 redis-cli -h "$p" -p 26379 --raw SENTINEL get-master-addr-by-name keel 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)
  if [ -n "$m" ]; then MASTER="$m"; break; fi
done
echo "keel-ha: current primary is $MASTER"
cat > "$CONF" <<SENTINEL
port 26379
dir /tmp
sentinel resolve-hostnames yes
sentinel announce-hostnames yes
sentinel announce-ip $ME
requirepass $PW
sentinel sentinel-pass $PW
sentinel monitor keel $MASTER 6379 ${KEEL_HA_QUORUM:-2}
sentinel auth-pass keel $PW
sentinel down-after-milliseconds keel 5000
sentinel failover-timeout keel 30000
sentinel parallel-syncs keel 1
SENTINEL
( while true; do redis-sentinel "$CONF" || true; sleep 2; done ) &
if [ "$MASTER" = "$ME" ]; then set --; else set -- --replicaof "$MASTER" 6379; fi
exec docker-entrypoint.sh redis-server --requirepass "$PW" --masterauth "$PW" --appendonly yes --replica-announce-ip "$ME" "$@"

services.name: redis-ha
services.start_command:
set -eu
CFG=/tmp/haproxy.cfg
PWE=$(printf '%s' "$REDISPASSWORD" | sed 's/ /\ /g')
{
  printf 'global
  maxconn 10000
  log stdout format raw local0 notice
'
  printf 'resolvers aven
  parse-resolv-conf
  hold valid 5s
  hold obsolete 5s
'
  printf 'defaults
  mode tcp
  log global
  timeout connect 5s
  timeout client 1h
  timeout server 1h
'
  printf '  default-server init-addr last,libc,none resolvers aven check inter 1s fall 2 rise 1 on-marked-down shutdown-sessions
'
  printf 'frontend redis
  bind :6379
  default_backend primary
'
  printf 'backend primary
  option tcp-check
  tcp-check connect
'
  printf '  tcp-check send AUTH\ %s\r\n
  tcp-check expect string +OK
' "$PWE"
  printf '  tcp-check send info\ replication\r\n
  tcp-check expect string role:master
'
  printf '  tcp-check send QUIT\r\n
  tcp-check expect string +OK
'
  i=0
  for n in $(printf '%s' "${KEEL_HA_NODES:-}" | tr ',' ' '); do i=$((i+1)); printf '  server node%s %s
' "$i" "$n"; done
} > "$CFG"
exec haproxy -W -db -f "$CFG"
